memory_candidates.content: When an `omega` call fails to close a Nat inequality even though `have` hypotheses appear to textually match the goal's subterms (per lean_goal), suspect atomization: omega treats syntactically-non-identical-but-print-identical terms (e.g. countP predicates elaborated in separate `have` statements vs. the goal produced by `unfold`) as distinct opaque atoms. Fix by `rw`-ing the goal into the exact hypothesis form (rw uses defeq-aware matching) instead of feeding independently-stated facts to omega. Seen in CSLib task 317 Phase 8 (Scheme.lean intExpMeasure_init_le_fuel).

The lean-lsp MCP tool lean_verify can report a spurious sorryAx axiom dependency for a declaration that is genuinely sorry-free; cross-check with a direct `#print axioms <name>` via `lake env lean` before trusting lean_verify's negative result. Seen in CSLib task 317 (intExpMeasure_init_le_fuel falsely flagged sorryAx by lean_verify, confirmed clean by #print axioms).
